name: dealloc
declaration: unsafe fn dealloc (ptr : * mut u8 , layout : Layout)
documentation:
Deallocates memory with the global allocator.

 This function forwards calls to the [`GlobalAlloc::dealloc`] method
 of the allocator registered with the `#[global_allocator]` attribute
 if there is one, or the `std` crate’s default.

 This function is expected to be deprecated in favor of the `deallocate` method
 of the [`Global`] type when it and the [`Allocator`] trait become stable.

 # Safety

 See [`GlobalAlloc::dealloc`].
rules: For safety, `ptr` must point to a block of memory currently allocated via the global allocator (the allocator registered with `#[global_allocator]`, if any, or the `std` crate’s default allocator).
For safety, `layout` must be the same layout that was used to allocate the block of memory pointed to by `ptr`.
